newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - LatAm ADRs little changed on weak Dow.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - LatAm ADRs little changed on weak Dow.

text.p: Latin American shares treaded water in thin U.S. trade Wednesday, dampened by the Dow's downward drift and a lack of market-moving news.
"In terms of turnover, it's dead quiet. The Dow's down, and nobody seems to be interested in Latin America," one trader said.
Traders expected fears of a possible rise in U.S. interest rates to put a damper on the market ahead of next Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
"People are very unlikely to make any big moves ahead of the Fed meeting next week," one said.
Among the region's major American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), Telmex inched up 1/8 to 33, Televisa was flat at 29-3/4, and Telebras added 1/4 to 78-5/8 by early afternoon.
YPF held steady at 22-5/8, Telefnica de Argentina was unmoved at 24-1/2, and CTC was flat at 99.
In other activity, Alcatel rose after posting gains in France on its offer to the French government to buy the Thomson SA group as a whole.
Alcatel's ADRs gained 3/8 to 14-7/8, while SGS-Thomson rose 1-1/4 to 47-7/8.
